# ai-models

Repository: https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models
Page: https://jwedwards-usa.github.io/ai-models/
Prompt: https://jwedwards-usa.github.io/ai-models/chatgpt-prompt.txt

## FILES

Preferred whisper.cpp ZIP:
https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/ggml-small.en.zip

ZIP checksum:
https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/ggml-small.en.zip.sha256

ZIP contents:
- ggml-small.en.bin
- ggml-small.en.bin.sha256
- ggml-small.en.manifest.json

Raw whisper.cpp model:
https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/ggml-small.en.bin

PyTorch ZIP:
https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/openai-whisper-small-en-offline-model.zip

Metadata:
https://jwedwards-usa.github.io/ai-models/model.json

## USE

    unzip ggml-small.en.zip
    whisper-cli -m ggml-small.en.bin -f audio.wav

Runtime not included.

## ACTIONS ARTIFACT

Workflow: `Update Whisper small.en`
Artifact: `openai-whisper-small-en-ggml-<model-sha-prefix>`
Retention: 90 days.

Use the Actions artifact if the release ZIP cannot be downloaded.

## UPDATE

The workflow is manual-only. It verifies the OpenAI checkpoint, converts missing GGML files with the official whisper.cpp converter, creates `ggml-small.en.zip`, publishes missing release assets, and refreshes the Actions artifact. Existing verified files are reused.

## SOURCE

https://github.com/openai/whisper
https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp
